plugins.name: authority-astrology
plugins.description: Calculate your birth chart and explore planets, houses and aspects with Swiss Ephemeris. Compare relationships with synastry and composite charts; explore transits, progressions, solar, lunar and Saturn returns, relocation and astrocartography. Ask Claude to explain the results in plain language. Start with your birth details, or connect to use saved profiles and save new charts. Exact, approximate and unknown birth times are handled explicitly.
